_form.merkel: Me_fill = C * (L/G)^(-n) * h^m, h = fill depth in m
_form.loss: K_fill = k * h * (Gw/Gw_ref)^d * (Ga/Ga_ref)^e ; dP_fill = K_fill * rho * v_air^2 / 2 (v at fill face)
_form.rain_zone: Me_rain = C * (L/G)^(-n) * H, H = height from fill bottom to basin water level in m
_form.spray_zone: Me_spray = constant (0 = conservative; most vendor fill curves already include the test cell's spray zone)

film.description: Cross-fluted PVC film fill, ~19 mm flute (generic)
film.basis: GENERIC - representative of published PVC film-fill ranges; replace with vendor curve (tower.fill_override) for any real design

low_clog_film.description: Vertical-flute / offset low-clog PVC film fill, ~25-30 mm flute (generic)
low_clog_film.basis: GENERIC - representative of published low-clog film ranges; replace with vendor curve for any real design

splash_grid.description: Plastic grid splash fill, rhombus bars 53 mm / 5 mm, 0.22 m layer pitch
splash_grid.basis: PUBLISHED - Vitkovic & Dvorak (2016), MCM'16 paper HTFF 127, eq. (2); counterflow test cell 1.47 x 1.47 m. Loss coefficient GENERIC.

rain_zone.basis: PUBLISHED - Vitkovic & Dvorak (2016), MCM'16 paper HTFF 127, eq. (3); measured H 1.45-3.03 m, L/G 1.0-2.0
